title: VroksNet provisioning manifest, version 1
description: /app/provisioning/vroksnet.yaml — what to configure at startup beyond the specs in /app/provisioning/specs. Everything is referenced by name, never by id. See docs/container-contract.md.

version.description: Manifest format version. An image with contract N accepts versions 1..N.

specifications.description: Settings for specs imported from specs/. Each entry must match an imported spec's info.title.

operationKey.description: "METHOD /path" for OpenAPI, "{channel address}:{action}" for AsyncAPI — as shown in the Admin UI.

value.description: The connection value as-is. Avoid secrets here; prefer valueFrom.

valueFrom.description: Configuration key to read the value from, e.g. "ConnectionStrings:kafka" (set by Aspire's WithReference).

providerMode.description: Serve every HTTP operation at its real path on the provider port. Overlapping operations are skipped, as in the Admin UI.

disabledOperations.description: HTTP operations to switch off; every other one stays enabled.

specification.description: info.title of an imported AsyncAPI spec.

exchange.description: Deprecated (ADR 0003; removed in contract v2): the same as brokerOptions.exchange. RabbitMQ only; omitted = the default exchange.

brokerOptions.description: Broker-specific settings the connection's type accepts (ADR 0003), e.g. { "exchange": "orders" } for RabbitMQ; GET /api/system/connection-types lists each type's options. An option the type doesn't know is a provisioning error.

payloadOverride.description: Message to publish instead of the spec's example; {{uuid}}/{{now}} are filled in.

scenarios.description: Test scenario names, in order: Sends run in this order, after every Listen has subscribed.

runOnStartup.description: Run the suite once each time the container starts, after provisioning succeeds. It doesn't hold up /health.

kind.description: Defaults as in the Admin UI: Listen for an AsyncAPI "send" operation, Send otherwise.

listenTimeoutSeconds.description: Up to 30 minutes; over 80 seconds the scenario only runs in the background.

exchange.description: Deprecated (ADR 0003; removed in contract v2): the same as brokerOptions.exchange. RabbitMQ only; omitted = the default exchange for a Send, amq.topic for a Listen.

brokerOptions.description: Broker-specific settings the connection's type accepts (ADR 0003), e.g. { "exchange": "orders" } for RabbitMQ; GET /api/system/connection-types lists each type's options. An option the type doesn't know is a provisioning error.

schedule.description: Runs the scenario in the background on a cron schedule (ADR 0002). Missed runs aren't caught up.

cron.description: Standard 5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5". No seconds field.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the expression is read in, e.g. "Europe/Kyiv". UTC if omitted.
